name: tide-wave
title: Tide Wave
description: The day's tide as a soft blue swell: the water draws in, drop lines mark highs and lows, and a dot glows at now.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas drawn on arrival and on change. The halo at now is one view on a UI-thread loop, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The swell appears whole, the dot jumps to its place and the halo holds still.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { TideWave } from '@/components/kinetik/tide-wave';

<TideWave
  tides={[
    { hour: 1, height: 1.2 },
    { hour: 7, height: 6.1 },
    { hour: 13, height: 0.8 },
    { hour: 19, height: 6.6 },
    { hour: 24, height: 2.1 },
  ]}
  now={9}
/>;
```

## When to use

- Sailing, surfing, fishing and coastal weather.
- Any smooth daily cycle with known highs and lows.

## When not to use

- Safety decisions at sea: the curve is a smooth estimate between the times you pass.

## Notes

- Pass each high and low with its hour, and the curve eases between them.
- The default unit is feet (′). Set `unit` to change the mark; the spoken label still says feet.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add tide-wave`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
